_README: NEW STORY SHOTS TEMPLATE. Copy to shots_mystory.json and reference it from config_mystory.yaml (shots_file:). Edit character_design, characters, and shots. Any field starting with _comment is IGNORED by the engine and is only guidance.

globals._comment: Global render defaults inherited by every shot. tone + negative_prompt set the overall look.
globals.tone: <EDIT> overall visual grammar, e.g. high-contrast expressionist cinema, IMAX-scale nocturnal atmosphere, 35mm grain
globals.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, illustration, cgi look, video-game render, low quality, blurry, soft focus, deformed anatomy, extra fingers, mutated hands, warped face, watermark, text

character_design._comment: One entry per character. forge_character.py turns forge_prompts into refs/<name>/face and refs/<name>/body. Keys here MUST match config character_forge.targets and the chars[] in shots. State that each character is an ORIGINAL fictional character, not a real person.

hero.summary: <EDIT> one paragraph: who they are, physical look, wardrobe, demeanor. Say 'original fictional character, not a real person'.

forge_prompts.face_front: cinematic portrait, <hero look>, front angle against dark background, single soft key light, photoreal, 35mm
forge_prompts.face_threequarter: cinematic portrait, same person, three-quarter angle, motivated light, photoreal
forge_prompts.face_profile: cinematic profile portrait, same person, profile against dark, rim light, photoreal
forge_prompts.body_full: full body cinematic shot, <hero> in <wardrobe>, natural posture, photoreal
forge_prompts.body_coat: full body, same person from behind and side, signature silhouette, photoreal

rival.summary: <EDIT> identity description for the second character (original fictional character).

forge_prompts.face_front: cinematic portrait, <rival look>, front angle, photoreal, 35mm
forge_prompts.face_threequarter: cinematic portrait, same person, three-quarter angle, photoreal
forge_prompts.face_profile: cinematic profile portrait, same person, profile, photoreal
forge_prompts.body_full: full body cinematic shot, <rival> in <wardrobe>, photoreal
forge_prompts.body_coat: full body, same person, signature silhouette, photoreal

characters._comment: Lightweight per-character token bag used to reinforce identity inside shot prompts. refs points at the forged folder.

hero.tokens: <EDIT> comma-separated identity tokens repeated for consistency

shots._comment: One object per shot. id must be UNIQUE and is referenced by config score.movements.shots. chars[] must match character_design keys. movement must match a score movement name.
shots.camera: wide, static, subject small and distant
shots.prompt: <EDIT> describe the shot action and composition
shots.negative: nudity, nude, cleavage, revealing clothing, sensual, suggestive, vulgar, deformed anatomy, extra fingers, watermark, text
shots.tone: cinematic realism, shot on 35mm with fine film grain, disciplined composition

shots.prompt: <EDIT> the two characters meet; describe blocking and emotion
shots.palette: warm lamp light against deep shadow, film grain

shots.tone: cinematic realism, shot on 35mm with fine film grain
